# Emergency Care System

> A public, free, open-source demonstration of how to plan an emergency
> care system, from higher-level use cases to lower-level test
> automation. All data anywhere in the repo is synthetic; this is not a
> real emergency care system.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) convention: a map
of this repository's key files for AI agents and LLMs, kept in sync with
`llms.json` (same content, structured) and with
[`spec/index.md`](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/blob/main/spec/index.md),
which is the canonical source of truth for both files.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/blob/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for AI coding agents working in this repository.
- [spec/index.md](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/blob/main/spec/index.md): tech stack, directory map, package manager, authentication, and how to add a new feature.
- [README.md](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/blob/main/README.md): project overview, setup, and how to run the app and its test suites.

## Specification

- [tests-with-given-when-then-features/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-given-when-then-features): the 22 Gherkin feature files -- the single source of truth for what each feature does.
- [spec/testing.md](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/blob/main/spec/testing.md): the twelve test suites' shared `data-testid` contract, architecture rules, and how to port a change across all twelve.

## The app

- [src/lib/features/registry.ts](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/blob/main/src/lib/features/registry.ts): the registry of all 22 feature panels.
- [src/lib/data/directory.ts](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/blob/main/src/lib/data/directory.ts): the demo login identities and scripted authentication scenarios.

## Test suites

- [tests-with-selenium-javascript/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-selenium-javascript): Selenium WebDriver + Mocha, in JavaScript -- the reference suite every other suite ports.
- [tests-with-playwright-javascript/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-playwright-javascript): Playwright, in JavaScript.
- [tests-with-selenium-typescript/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-selenium-typescript): Selenium WebDriver + Mocha, in TypeScript.
- [tests-with-playwright-typescript/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-playwright-typescript): Playwright, in TypeScript.
- [tests-with-selenium-python/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-selenium-python): Selenium WebDriver + pytest, in Python.
- [tests-with-playwright-python/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-playwright-python): Playwright + pytest, in Python.
- [tests-with-selenium-c-sharp/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-selenium-c-sharp): Selenium WebDriver + NUnit, in C#.
- [tests-with-playwright-c-sharp/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-playwright-c-sharp): Playwright + NUnit, in C#.
- [tests-with-selenium-java/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-selenium-java): Selenium WebDriver + JUnit 5, in Java.
- [tests-with-playwright-java/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-playwright-java): Playwright + JUnit 5, in Java.
- [tests-with-selenium-rust/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-selenium-rust): Selenium WebDriver (thirtyfour) + libtest-mimic, in Rust.
- [tests-with-playwright-rust/](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/tree/main/tests-with-playwright-rust): Playwright (playwright-rs) + libtest-mimic, in Rust.

## Skills

- [skills/index.md](https://github.com/emergency-care-system/emergency-care-system/blob/main/skills/index.md): Claude Code skills used while building this repo.
